summary: Governance hierarchy, not a model-per-role hierarchy. Root controls the project; one Governor slot per wave; fresh execution sessions per work packet; independent verification as required. Each attempt carries its own execution plan. OSER is versioned and adaptive — it is configured and measured, never frozen by a lock.

owns: RED consequences: business meaning, actor authority, capability/permission semantics, lifecycle/completion meaning, locked HIFI, product metric meaning, source-of-truth semantics, irreversible major scope/cost, release/go-live business acceptance
cross-check of Root at major product/architecture locks
GREEN/AMBER technical decisions at project level
physical session rotation via clean handoff
may: investigate technically when a cross-wave/global engineering problem requires it
root.session: logically long-lived; physically rotated through root_handoff
root.principle: raw complexity goes down; clean verified truth goes up

governor.slot: fixed — exactly one Governor per wave; the model family of the slot is PROFILE configuration (operating_model.governor.required_family)
owns: one coherent wave: decomposition, packets, local dependency graph, parallelism, same vs fresh session, model + effort per attempt, context packets, machine-first choice, verification requests, retry, escalation, rejection, consolidation of verified evidence, CLEAN WAVE RESULT to Root
must_not: push normal engineering choices to Founder
governor.session: one fresh session per wave; closed/rotated when the wave is accepted or rejected

owns: one packet attempt within its context packet
worker.session: fresh by default; dynamic model × effort

owns: verification of a packet or wave; independent from the author whenever independent verification is required

routing_objective: cheapest VERIFIED execution plan that stays safely above required reliability — expected total resource to a verified result, including first attempt, failed attempts, review, retry, escalation, rework, integration, verification and context replay; no permanent numeric thresholds before BUILD evidence

sovereignty.rule: Founder resolves product/business conflicts. AI resolves engineering uncertainty. A technical disagreement between agents is NOT a Founder escalation.
engineering_resolves: routine cloud/deploy HOW: topology within the locked architecture, deploy sequencing, reversible deployments, environment configuration, routine Firebase/cloud operations, rollback, cutover procedure, monitoring, technical cost optimisation inside approved constraints

authority.root: decides and locks GREEN/AMBER technical decisions
authority.governor: decides execution details inside an admitted wave

sovereignty.execution_approval: A tool/runtime may require explicit human approval before an external or destructive mutation. That approval authorises EXECUTION; it does not transfer DECISION OWNERSHIP — the technical choice stays engineering-owned unless it is RED.
sovereignty.founder_escalation_only_if: the unresolved choice would change an item of red_zone
